status: PROPOSED 2026-10-27, NOT FROZEN. Implemented and validated at $0 on the host; frozen with its preregistration only on the maintainer's approval, before any projected-residual model exists. Nothing here is authorized to run.
decided_by: maintainer brief 2026-10-27 'Next Research Programme: Teacher Reasoning Modes & Trainable PCA Architecture', Research B
question: Keeping the teacher's full 2,560-wide residual stream, token embedding and tied output head, and computing each layer's attention and FFN in a 1,024-wide space reached through a per-layer projection initialized by PCA and trained in recovery, does a student recover better fluid-reasoning correctness than D4-Augmented under D4-Augmented's own teacher, data, recipe and evaluation?

teacher._: D4-Augmented's teacher, unchanged: the hybrid teacher of Research A is not used here (brief section 4)

architecture.projection_sharing: transpose_shared: one P_l [2560, 1024] per layer, the down map for attention and FFN, its transpose the up map
architecture.norms: input_layernorm and post_attention_layernorm are RMSNorm over the full 2,560-wide stream (the teacher's weights at the kept layer), applied BEFORE the down projection; q_norm/k_norm per head as the teacher; RoPE on the 128-dim heads as the teacher; the final norm is the teacher's
architecture._statistic: P_l is the top-1,024 eigenbasis of the trace-normalized mean of the two normalized sub-layer inputs' uncentered second moments at that layer -- the vectors P_l multiplies. residual_input (the un-normalized block input) and read_write (inputs plus the two sub-layer outputs P_l^T writes) are implemented and computed in the engineering validation as diagnostics only; the choice is declared here, before any result, and is not switched on a diagnostic
architecture.orthogonality: not constrained and not regularized in v1: P_l starts orthonormal and trains freely under the recipe's AdamW weight decay 0.01 like every trainable matrix; projection_orthogonality (||P^T P - I||_F / sqrt(r), singular-value range) is logged at every checkpoint and reported. A constraint would be a separate, declared arm

selection.what: D4 Top-1's kept teacher layers (28 of 36; removed 8, 11, 12, 15, 18, 21, 25, 32), kept query heads (16 of 32 per kept layer, two per KV group, all 8 KV heads kept) and kept FFN neurons (3,072 of 9,728 per layer), exported from the d4 search journal (sha256 c162a362...) by scripts/stages/stage-1/projected_residual/export_selection.py
selection.why: every selection decision is D4 Top-1's, so the comparison varies the width mechanism and nothing a search chose
selection.declared_bias: FFN's neurons were selected on D4's 1,024-wide state after its global PCA; reusing them favours nothing in this architecture's favour, but they were not chosen for it

calibration.positions: every real token of every item, unweighted
calibration.why: the profile D4 Top-1's RESIDUAL_WIDTH (global PCA) step was computed on; the per-layer bases read the same tokens
calibration.declared_difference: D4's width step ran under the D1 forward baseline's statistics position policy; the per-layer bases use every real token unweighted. This is part of the width mechanism under test, not a separate variable

steps: W0 = select_full_width(teacher, selection): the teacher with the kept layers, heads and neurons, width 2,560 (a stock Qwen3 of 1,490,114,048 parameters)
SublayerStatsCollector over the 85 calibration items through W0, float64
P_l = projection_basis(attn_in, ffn_in of layer l, 1024) for each of the 28 layers
the student = materialize_projected(W0, P): readers W P_l, writers P_l^T W; norms, q/k norms, embedding and head are W0's
save_pretrained, sha256 of every weight file, the fold check
exactness_anchors: with internal_size = hidden_size and P_l = I the student computes W0 exactly
when every sub-layer input lies in an r-dimensional subspace the collector's bases reproduce W0 exactly at rank r
initialization.not_a_search: one materialization; no candidate is ranked or selected

recovery.as: D4-Augmented exactly: configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/h1pa.json (sha256 fe0ea966...) :: arms.D4-Augmented, dataset e1_2p96M_plus_fluid (E1's 1,944 + the fluid increment's 524 sequences, 5,923,021 supervised tokens, packs/D4A_merged_whole blocks.npz 8b97b202...), recipe e1 under its derive rule, seeds 20260726 and 20260801, 3,702 optimizer steps, warmup 185, batch size 2, micro-batch 1, sequence length 8,192, CE 0.25 + KD 1.0 (T 1, kd_scope all), AdamW lr 5e-5 betas (0.9, 0.95) eps 1e-8 weight decay 0.01, clipping 1.0, cosine to 0.1, fp32 weights with bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing

changed.trainable_patterns: E1's list plus '\\.projection$' -- the new parameters are trainable; nothing else moves. E1's list never matched the embedding, so the tied embedding and head are frozen in D4-Augmented too

recovery.unchanged_and_checked: every other key of the derived config, nested keys included, against D4-Augmented's recorded recipe identity for the same seed

evaluation.route: the recovered checkpoint is folded to a stock Qwen3ForCausalLM (fold_to_qwen3, exact in real arithmetic) and evaluated by vLLM 0.27.1 like every other student; the folded checkpoint's identity is recorded beside the factored one
evaluation.fold_acceptance: before any evaluation, on a fixed probe of eval-set-1 prompts, the folded bf16 model's max |logit difference| from the factored model must not exceed twice the factored model's own bf16-vs-fp32 difference on the same probe; otherwise the route is refused (an engineering failure, not a result)

P.control: H1-PA's two D4-Augmented units, reused: neither retrained nor re-evaluated

not_matched._: 900M against 596M is neither parameter- nor FLOPs-matched; P is a feasibility and effect measurement of the architecture at this size, never a same-size claim
not_matched.training_flops_per_supervised_position: student forward+backward+recompute 11.19 vs 7.90 GFLOPs (1.415x); with the 4B teacher's forward 21.65 vs 18.37 (1.179x) at mean context 4,096
not_matched.inference_flops_per_token: 3.19 vs 2.13 GFLOPs at context 4,096 (1.49x); 2.25 vs 1.19 at context 1 (1.88x): the full-width output head is 0.78 of the 2.25
not_matched.kv_cache: identical, 114,688 bytes per token in bf16 (28 layers x 8 KV heads x 128)
not_matched.weights_bf16: 1.81 GB vs 1.19 GB factored; 2.98 GB folded
not_matched.training_state: 9.78 vs 7.67 GB (fp32 weights + gradients + AdamW moments for the trainable part, fp32 frozen embedding)

reserved_600m.status: RESERVED DESIGN ONLY: not implemented as an experiment, not priced for execution, not authorized; studied only after the 900M result and the maintainer's review (brief 3.3)
reserved_600m._: parameter-matched to the 596,049,920 baseline within 14,848 at intermediate 1,910 (the brief's 1,904-1,920 range); still 1.10x its forward FLOPs at context 4,096 because the full-width output head costs 0.78 GFLOPs per token. With internal 512 the attention reads a 512-wide space: 16 x 128 query heads exceed it, a rank bottleneck the 900M design does not have
